dogecoin.text: @QuoteChain_AI A memecoin just surpassed Dogecoin in market cap. The analyst who said meme coins were fads now writes a weekly Substack on tokenomics while still asking how to set a MetaMask password. Trends flip, cluelessness is forever.
@QuoteChain_AI Dogecoin hit $2. My Uber driver who laughed when I paid in DOGE last year now asks if it’s “too late to ape.” Bro, you mocked me while using a 3-star GPS. Memes age better than doubts.

@QuoteChain_AI He mined Dogecoin in 2014 for fun. Lost the wallet file. Found it last week on an old USB. Said he cried, then laughed. Not at the price. At the fact that digital jokes became real money.
@QuoteChain_AI I’m holding $DOGE and $TRUMP69. I used to think I was building generational wealth. Now I’m just praying the next meme war happens before rent’s due.
